bullets.text: Merged PRs took a median 5.0 days from ready for review to merge; 1 in 10 took about 52 days or longer.
295 open PRs have had no human response yet, with a median wait of 37 days.
303 open PRs are waiting for a reviewer's lgtm, with a median wait of 62 days.
sig/api-machinery has 104 PRs waiting for a reviewer's lgtm, with a median wait of 66 days.
More open PRs are waiting on their author (383, median wait 23 days) than for a reviewer's lgtm (303).
